name: qkd_kvs_attn_rv6

pin_regs.reason: Every public pin is registered IN THE RTL (checklist 1): d2d RX record/event land straight in the codec landing flops (no logic, no enable), TX slot pins in ls_* flops, uf* fault pins one flop per pin, fin / i_ctl in ot_pin_land face flops (issue: 12 kept face copies); every output is a flop (tx launch, prg launch, root/face registers; OT_KEEP_PIN_REGS + pin_reg_split give each output pin its own launch flop). A kit recipe-3 pin register would add an unpriced edge to every crossing.

structural_change: KV-ATTN4 10-20 (COORD 09:56 decision, tree K.STA.ATTN): rv3 successor r17 = r16 + RESET (landed rst_n, flop reset pins) of the calendar data stages S1..S9 (qkd_attn_cal_gen_r17: control state; the rv3 native audit was NOT PROVEN 1089/1091 on the unreset S1..S9 startup transient, Codex CEX step 7/8). Datapath stays unreset. Reset landed by the kit (2-stage, 2 first / 64 final kept copies, <= 32 loads per copy). Same ports, same edges as rv3 (0 cycles; reset release latency unchanged = 2). Pair lockstep vs ba5 RS=1 SD=213 + mutants 1-7 + calendar reset witness (MUT 8 = r16 form FAILs).
